planner_prompt: Inspect this product image for a visible anomaly. You may inspect at most one close-up. Choose whether another view is useful. Output exactly one JSON object, with no prose: {"action":"crop","center":[x,y]} or {"action":"answer"}. x and y are finite normalized coordinates between 0 and 1 in the original image; x increases rightward, y downward. The crop has fixed width and height of one third of the original image. Use only visible image content. Do not guess an unseen defect.
final_prompt: Now give the final decision for the original product. If a close-up image is supplied, it is sampled from the original at the recorded bounds. An unchanged view is explicitly marked as a duplicate. Is there any anomaly in the original product? Answer with Yes or No first, followed by one brief sentence about visible evidence. Do not request further tools.
inference_inputs: RGB only; cache labels/categories used for subset selection and metrics only
